scope: Read-only static audit of the pinned El Cap SET22 command-skip branches, no-op idle checks, and outer WorkLoop gate admission.

skip_path.notes: Post-CfgFind skip block writes local authentication state and clears six local bytes. _IOSleep is used elsewhere in the image, not in this setter block. getVirtIf is before CfgFind and excluded from this branch-specific claim.

set_ibss.mode_identity: WLC_SET_INFRA command 0x14 handler stores requested boolean to byte wlc+0x263a; nonzero is infrastructure mode in this sample.
set_ibss.false_argument_early_return_effect: clear controller+0x590, then return without calls to _wlc_down, setAP, _wlc_set, _wlc_get, or _wl_up
reconfiguration_effects: if byte [controller+0x420 pointer]+0x20 is nonzero, call _wlc_down at 0x4d90
if previously-up byte was nonzero, call _wl_up at 0x4e2c
set_ibss.guard_needed_for_idle_success: Require wlc+0x263a != 0 before native setter, after setter, and after outer provider return.

outer_gate.condition: controller and interface share WorkLoop and loop->inGate() is true before runtime dispatch
outer_gate.lease_recheck: legacy_install.cpp:174-182 verifies controller/interface/timer WorkLoop and inGate

current_source_snapshot.infra_predicate: readNativeIdle requires byte [wlc+0x263a] != 0; readNativeIdle is called before setter, after setter, and after outer provider return.
current_source_snapshot.source_review: Predicate placement and repeated checks reviewed read-only; this agent did not run tests or a build.

remaining_semantic_boundary: perform's idle-success branch skips CacheKernel::prune even when flush is present. This report certifies the local skip predicate and gate safety only; it does not claim flush metadata was consumed or all native FSM states are equivalent. See build/research/disassociate-empty-state-semantics.md.
unclosed_indirect_paths_excluded_from_ac: 43224 zero-infrastructure reconfiguration path reaches _wlc_down, _wl_del_timer and a Timer::delTimer timerSource virtual call at vtable slot +0x218, WLC ioctl handlers, and possibly _wl_up.
This audit does not claim every such unrelated indirect callee preserves WorkLoop gate ownership; the idle predicate must exclude that path.
